scope: development rehearsal of the existing flat and Climbing baseline controller. All groups have already participated in earlier supervised pilots.
unit: one documented representative per distinct HAM seed-17 split group
proxy_calibration: pool the original and alternative risk-fit development cohorts (256) for calibration of the fixed baseline policies only; no risk-regression model is used
oracle: using true labels, retain every correct predicted leaf; on other rows return the deepest correct nonroot ancestor if one exists, otherwise root. Both zero-error acceptance counts and their one-sided bounds are optimistic limits for fixed mode-path actions.
report: all sixteen fixed candidate counts and bounds for each readout and budget, selected policy or full abstention, label-aware oracle bounds, and agreement with direct binomial test inversion. Each readout assessed separately.
interpretation: development workflow rehearsal; no formal calibration, independent patient sampling or clinical risk claim
